summary: Braiin Limited filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026, announcing a landmark partnership with BillCentral Pty Ltd to deploy its Agentic AI-powered customer experience platform. This is a commercial agreement, not a special situation involving acquisitions, divestitures, or similar categories. No financial terms, stake percentages, or advisory roles were disclosed. Filing is routine for a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, reporting entry into a material definitive agreement (a partnership contract). Watched for revenue impact but no structural corporate event triggers risk-arb analysis.
